title: Ask Again
concept: A dented, duct-taped fortune ball is shaken with the state's ten-year jobs forecast. Asked for an AI number it gives none, and the film follows what the report actually says about AI, down to the one honest labeled blank, planted beside the one sector the report names.

fingerprint.palette: obsidian black, cranberry, tundra ochre, ptarmigan bone, glacier cyan window, pale overcast slate and river gravel
fingerprint.metaphor: a dented fortune ball asked to predict a decade, answering with a labeled blank instead of a made-up number

palette: obsidian black, cranberry, tundra ochre, ptarmigan bone, glacier cyan window, pale overcast slate and river gravel
divergence_note: A mostly exterior film: a gravel bar of pebble rows, a river edge, a stake-flag field and an ink test stage on the same table, in a pale overcast that goes to one cool spot and then a rift of light. 10-06 was a warm pine stove-lit night interior at counter height with a polished brass bell, 10-05 a seafoam fluorescent hallway at noon, 10-03 a newsprint cream newsroom. The hero is a dented matte-black sphere that is the darkest value in frame, ROUND AND MENDED against FACETED AND CREASED (a faceted die, cut stakes, creased pages, angular pebbles), with no look-alike decoy of the hero and the ball's face kept off the data shots (S2, S5, S6, S8, S9, S13 never show it, S12 and S13 are staged on the gravel). An overcast tundra palette has run before (07-14, 07-31 pale arctic overcast with tundra ochre), so the divergence here is the cranberry-only-for-the-named-sector licence, the cyan-only-for-what-the-ball-says licence, the sphere against stakes, and an ending where the AI row is a labeled blank stake with no number, carried by a ptarmigan and planted beside the sector the report names.

angle.thesis: Alaska's economists put AI in the ten-year jobs forecast and refused to invent its size, so the scary rows (journalists, broadcasters) are not the AI rows, and the one sector they name, finance and insurance, is the place to watch.
angle.falsifiable_by: The report crediting the journalist, broadcaster or information declines to AI, printing an AI job number, or finance and insurance not being the sector its sidebar names as most vulnerable. Next year's edition putting a number on insurance AI losses closes the window.
supporting_facts: c4 sidebar: AI will touch much of the labor force but no current broad shift can be attributed to it
c5 finance and insurance named most vulnerable to automation near term
c8/c9 journalists -27.9 and broadcasters -27.7 with the report's own non-AI reasons (remote services, freelance, small numbers)
c7 insurance AI losses 'too uncertain to project this year'
c2/c10 the forecast still adds 8,577 jobs, health care +5,954
angle.fair_counterpoint: A forecast built from history can't see a break from history, which is what AI would be, and it excludes the self-employed and fishermen (c14, c15). A blank spot where AI should be is a real limit and the reader could fairly call it evasion. It gets its own scene (THE TEST) at full strength, then the film lands that a labeled blank beats a number nobody could defend, and the state's own 'this year' (c7) sets the next test.
angle.second_movement: c8/c9: the biggest shrink numbers look like an AI story and the report says they aren't. The AI flag sits in a quieter row (c5, c6), and its number is never tied to AI.
angle.valence: even-handed and constructive, crediting the economists' discipline, with the caution kept in
runner_ups: Builder: early warning not obituary (merged as the close, lead time to act)
Skeptic: the sidebar can't be tested against its own forecast (kept as the counter-scene, since 'untestable' alone is a description not a call to action)
Explainer: the most useful number is the one they refused to write (merged into the thesis)
angle.cross_challenge: All three converged. Synthesis applied: (1) skeptic's thesis stated a limitation, not a claim, so it became the scene THE TEST. (2) builder's 'early warning Alaska can act on' overreaches since the report recommends nothing, so it is the question at the button, not the thesis. (3) explainer's derived ratios (12x, 69 percent) are NOT approved facts and stay off screen. Hard guardrail from all three: never put -27.9 or -27.7 beside AI without the report's non-AI reason in the same beat.

treatment.why: Only pitch that gives the forecast a face. A battered fortune ball that sweats at the sidebar, flinches at the scary rows and goes mortified in The Test carries emotion in every act, and the toy's own vocabulary (ask again) is the button. Grafts: the Dramatist's survey stakes with each row's reason tied on at planting and the labeled-blank transfer, the Enthusiast's labeled blank as something Alaska can plan around, the Explainer's pebble rows making the numbers physical, and the Test restaged as a raven's projection line missed by a boulder. The ice-survey and lighthouse pitches were sound but faceless in their middles.

shots.title: The ball slams down

The die rolls and lands on a face reading TOO UNCERTAIN TO PROJECT THIS YEAR, the ball's pupils stuck on it, then it tumbles to a new face, WHICH ROW IS THE AI ROW. shots.title: The scary rows
shots.centered: the first flag at x420 y1000
shots.means: High and wide over the tundra bar. Survey stakes drop into the gravel one by one. The ptarmigan carries each reason tag in its beak and ties it to the pole as the stake lands, REPORTERS + JOURNALISTS -27.9% with SERVICES GOING REMOTE and FREELANCE WORK, then BROADCASTERS -27.7% with the same tags. The camera rises to show the whole bar.
shots.ambient: flags flutter on irrational periods, tundra sway, river shimmer, the ptarmigan pecks between stakes

shots.title: Through the flags
shots.means: Ground level through the two flags. The huge percentages fill the foreground and loom as the camera dollies in, then the reason tags swing across and cover them. The ball is only a small dark silhouette on the table far behind, a cyan pinpoint for a window, its face not visible.
shots.ambient: flags flutter, tag cloth ripples, tundra sway, the ptarmigan pecks beside the far stake, a cyan pinpoint pulses in the far ball

shots.title: The fair objection
shots.means: The overcast goes to ink on the same table as a cool-white spot drops. The raven (feathers lifted to a rimmed blue-grey, perched inside the spot's rim) drags a short row of pebbles out of the open report onto the table, then draws a dashed projection line out of that lit row across the planks past a METHOD stake, then a boulder drops inside the spot onto the planks where the line never pointed. The EXCLUDES SELF-EMPLOYED + FISHERMEN stake marks a roped-off empty patch with no pebbles that the line runs straight over. The die floats up blank in the window and the ball goes mortified. The cut is the spot's iris closing on the table (mask-wipe).
shots.ambient: spot dust drifts, the raven's pencil scratches, the dashed line crawls, the ball breathes

hero.name: ForecastTrace
hero.detail_note: 40% ball and spot, 30% raven and projection line, 30% ink

shots.title: The limit, and the label
shots.means: Inside the window under the cool spot, opening on the die floating up with a blank face. The raven's grease-pencil tip reaches in from frame right and writes, on the OUTSIDE of the glass registered over the blank, the report's own words as a short label, conceding. The die holds still square to the glass. The label lights warm #F4D9A0, the only warm lit thing in the ink and the film's one cyan-to-warm change.
shots.ambient: bubbles rise past the glass, the glow breathes, the die holds still square to the glass

shots.title: Nobody could defend
shots.means: Wide on the spot, the same table on the gravel bar. The conceding raven plants a bare survey stake in the gravel at the table's foot and the labeled die face slides out of the window onto it, the AI stake. Then the raven plants two kraft-cardboard stakes with crossed-out scrawl stamped MADE UP in the gravel, they topple off and drop into a bucket marked NOBODY COULD DEFEND THIS. The raven lowers its pencil.
shots.ambient: spot dust, the cardboard stakes wobble, the bucket rocks, the ball breathes

hero.name: StakeFlag
hero.detail_note: 40% stakes and bucket, 30% ball, 30% spot and ink

shots.title: The AI row
shots.centered: the cranberry flag at x640 y900
shots.means: Pull back and up over the whole bar as a rift opens in the cloud. The two scary flags go grey under their reasons. The ptarmigan tugs the labeled AI stake upright in the gravel beside the cranberry finance flag (its row visibly shorter), no number on it, then walks to its foot and settles facing the cranberry flag. Rift light rakes pale across the bar, the label alone glowing warm. The cut carries the dragged labeled stake from the ink into the daylight (carried-element).
shots.ambient: flags flutter, tundra sway, the ptarmigan shuffles and settles, the river glints, the light rift widens

shots.title: Ask again
shots.means: The mitten sets the ball down gently on the table in a break of light (the table is the same table). The window settles on ASK AGAIN NEXT FORECAST. The report's fine print rises in bone below. Far behind the ball the ptarmigan stays at the foot of the labeled stake, the film's watch post, and the ball blinks once.
shots.ambient: tundra sway, rift light drifts across the bar, the ptarmigan breathes at the far stake, the liquid settles
